core.description: Core — platform-free: a Gesture Provider that any touch source feeds plain finger samples, finding its zones through a Zone Tree it is handed; the Direction a touch first moves; what a Swipe decides; the Tree Walk a picker moves through as a finger goes; and the Thumb Lock, a still left thumb beside a moving finger. No DOM, no React, no Motion: a browser and a phone both build on it.

provider runs the one Gesture under way and reads its Direction; swipe judges a Swipe by Direction; tree-walk reads a finger's moves as Directions through a tree; thumb-lock is a provider listener that reads a still left thumb beside a moving finger. Each stands on direction, and thumb-lock on provider too.

entry.description: Entry — the package root, the platform-free core's one door: what a touch source on any platform builds on, the web's included.

web-zones.description: Web zones — the browser as the touch source: a GestureProvider feeds the core every touch and pen pointer on the page and holds the browser back on each zone, leaving Native Scrolls their touches; GestureZones are DOM elements; useGesture hands each enabled listener every finger as motion values. It never says what a Gesture means.

zones.description: touch-input listens to the page, holds the browser back on each zone and says how zones nest in the DOM; zone runs the core's provider over it and puts it together for React with motion values. Whether a release clicks is the browser's call unless a listener prevents it

web-recognizers.description: Web recognizers — one generic meaning read from a Gesture, such as a Swipe: Possible, then Tracking with live motion values for feedback, then a Commit or a Cancel, decided by the core's rules. They never know about each other.

recognizers.description: Each Recognizer reads Pointers from useGesture on its own.

web-patterns.description: Web patterns — purpose-built touch behaviours an app uses as they are, built from Recognizers, giving exactly the motion values their UI needs and settling themselves.

patterns.description: Each Pattern stands alone on the Recognizers.

web-entry.description: Web entry — `./web`: the provider, zone and useGesture, the Recognizers and the Patterns, for apps in a browser.

use-gesture.description: Read bottom-up: the platform-free core and its door; the web builds on that door the way any other platform would, and nothing below `./web` ever imports it.
